articles.summary: Agreements include software integration and operational testing, expanding Joby’s defense autonomy work with USAF AFWERX across two primary contracts The contract expansion follows the record setting autonomous cross-country flights in the J208, spanning 6,665 miles with landings in 11 states and integrated flight operations across 24 states
articles.title: Joby Expands Autonomous Flight Contracts with U.S. Air Force to Nearly $37 Million Following Record Coast-to-Coast Tour
